page_title: VAL 1-0 GET | Valencia v Getafe 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.

86' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Giorgi Mamardashvili with a fabulous save. Getafe earn a corner.
85' Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity.

85' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top left corner. The ball is out of play and Getafe manage to earn a corner.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) for Nemanja Maksimovic.
84' Substitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez walks off the pitch and Yellu Santiago (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
84' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Hugo Duro is replaced by Selim Amallah (Valencia).
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Thierry Correia (Valencia) is replacing Javi Guerra.

83' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Diego Lopez (Valencia) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but David Soria pulls off a brilliant save.
82' Djene (Getafe) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
80' A pass from Diego Lopez (Valencia) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
78' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
75' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia). Juan Pulido saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
74' Rough tackle by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Here's the change. Gaston Alvarez leaves the pitch and Diego Rico (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
71' Ruben Baraja has decided to substitute Roman Yaremchuk and he is replaced by Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
69' Valencia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
69' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Pepelu (Valencia) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
66' Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to intercept the corner from Omar Alderete (Getafe).
64' The resulting corner from Omar Alderete (Getafe) comes to nothing. Getafe will take a corner kick.
62' Substitution. Jordi Martin (Getafe) has come on for Ilaix Moriba.
61' That will be all from Carles Alena who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe).
59' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Diego Lopez (Valencia) replacing Sergi Canos.
59' It will be a substitution. Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) is ready to enter the pitch as Fran Perez walks off.

57' Javi Guerra (Valencia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Pulido with no other option than to blow for a foul.
55' Hugo Duro (Valencia) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
54' The attendance for today's match is 37961.
51' Flag goes up against Jaime Mata (Getafe) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

51' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Giorgi Mamardashvili is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
47' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

47' Giorgi Mamardashvili was forced into action to thwart Jaime Mata (Getafe). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
46' Pepelu (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Pulido has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' Referee Juan Pulido blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45+3' Getafe take a short corner kick.
45+2' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Getafe.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' The game is interrupted now, Omar Alderete (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Sergi Canos gets to the ball, slips Hugo Duro (Valencia) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 1:0.
38' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' The game is interrupted. Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
33' Sergi Canos (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Pulido no option but to blow his whistle.
31' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
29' Sergi Canos (Valencia) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
29' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
28' Sergi Canos (Valencia) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Valencia get a corner.
27' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
25' Sergi Canos (Valencia) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
24' Valencia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' Carles Alena (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

19' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
16' Sergi Canos (Valencia) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!
15' Pepelu (Valencia) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
13' It looks like Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) saw red with that tackle. Juan Pulido won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
10' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
9' Juan Pulido couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) and blew his whistle.
8' Carles Alena (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
4' Djene (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Juan Pulido stops the game and makes a call.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Pulido.
